patterns.content: Null safety: use ? for nullable types. Safe call ?.let { }, Elvis operator ?: default, !! only when null is a program error. Prefer ? over !! everywhere.
Data classes for DTOs: data class User(val name: String, val age: Int) — free copy(), equals(), hashCode(), toString(), componentN() functions.
Extension functions: fun String.capitalizeWords(): String = split(' ').joinToString(' ') { it.capitalize() } — extend third-party classes without inheritance.
Scope functions: let (transform and return), also (side-effect and return same), apply (configure and return same), run (execute block and return result), with (call multiple methods).
When expression replaces switch: when (x) { is Int -> ... ; in 1..10 -> ... ; else -> ... }. Must be exhaustive when used as expression.
Coroutines for async: suspend fun fetch(): T with launch/async builders. Structured concurrency via CoroutineScope — cancellation propagates automatically.
Sealed classes for state machines and ADTs: sealed class Result<T>. Exhaustive when branches without else. Prefer over enum when variants carry data.
Delegation: class LoggingList<T>(private val inner: MutableList<T>) : MutableList<T> by inner — delegates all interface methods to inner, override only what you need.
val over var everywhere possible. Immutable by default, mutable only when necessary. Use copy() on data classes instead of mutating.
Collection builders: listOf(), mapOf(), setOf() for immutable; mutableListOf() for mutable. Avoid Java ArrayList/HashMap directly.
